caption: The drawing depicts a decorative panel with a curved, pointed top edge and straight sides. At the center of the panel, there is a large peacock rendered in shades of brown, prominently featured with its body facing forward and its head turned to its left. The peacock stands on an elaborate network of branches that extend horizontally across the panel, spreading out from the center. These branches are adorned with large, detailed flowers and broad leaves, also in shades of brown. The background behind the peacock and the floral elements is a contrasting light gray, with subtle shading. The composition is symmetrical along the vertical axis, with the peacock as the central focal point and the floral branches and blooms radiating out from around it. The overall color palette is primarily brown for the carved figures and light gray for the background.
title: Peacock Stern Carving
